notes: Spring Grove Avenue's name is printed only west of the strip (about x 1000-1500, y 4920); it is the wide diagonal avenue with car tracks and sewers. Mitchell Avenue's name is printed only on its south-east leg and far north (x 2000, y 700); the north leg in this strip carries only 'AVENUE'. Mitchell / Donnell / Spring Grove form one five-way junction: Mitchell recorded as one cross at the midpoint of its two offset legs (see bends), Donnell as a T beside it. Durham Avenue at Spring Grove read as a T (only a water pipe and rail spur continue north-west). Railroad Avenue x Durham Avenue lies at about (4805, 2945), outside the 300 px margin, not recorded. Chickering Avenue runs on south-east to Spring Grove Avenue at about (4790, 1740), also outside the margin. Mitchell Avenue crosses no street between Spring Grove and the Mill Creek inside the strip (railroads only).
